meta.name: dot-ai-prd-next
meta.description: Analyze existing PRD to identify and recommend the single highest-priority task to work on next

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从现有产品需求文档中找出最优先的下一步任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有产品需求文档，需要确定下一步该做什么。
copy.tagline_en: Identify the single highest-priority next task from your existing PRD.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a PRD and need to decide what to work on next.

howto.what: Claude 会分析已有的产品需求文档（PRD），找出当前最应该优先完成的一个任务，并给出理由。如果你同意，它会帮你讨论具体的设计方案。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 PRD 或询问下一步该做什么时触发。如果近期对话中已明确 PRD 上下文，会直接推荐任务；否则会自动检测 PRD 并分析。

say.text: 帮我看看这个 PRD 下一步该做什么？
say.note: Claude 会分析 PRD 并推荐最高优先级的任务。

say.text: 分析当前 PRD，找出最重要的待办任务。
say.note: Claude 会检测 PRD 并给出推荐。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes an existing PRD to identify and recommend the single highest-priority task to work on next, with rationale. If confirmed, it discusses implementation design.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze a PRD or what to do next. If PRD context is clear from recent conversation, it skips detection; otherwise it auto-detects the PRD and analyzes it.

say_en.text: What should I work on next for this PRD?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the PRD and recommend the top task.

say_en.text: Analyze the current PRD and find the most important next task.
say_en.note: Claude will detect the PRD and give a recommendation.
